crossRefs.note: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law…
He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things…
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
translations.bsb: “Then bring me your livestock,” said Joseph. “Since the money is gone, I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
translations.asv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
